```cypher
MATCH (t:Territory {name: 'Canada'})<-[:IN_TERRITORY]-(o:SalesOrder)
WHERE o.order_date >= date('2024-01-01') AND o.order_date < date('2025-01-01')
MATCH (o)-[l:HAS_LINE]->(p:Product)
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (p)-[:HAS_SUBASSEMBLY|HAS_PART*1..6]->(c:Product {product_number: 'FK-1639'})
WHERE all(r IN relationships(path) WHERE r.valid_from <= o.order_date AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date <= r.valid_to))
WITH o, l, p, c, path
WITH o, l, p,
     CASE WHEN p.product_number = 'FK-1639' THEN l.order_qty ELSE 0 END AS direct_qty,
     CASE WHEN c IS NOT NULL THEN l.order_qty * reduce(acc = 1.0, r IN relationships(path) | acc * r.qty) ELSE 0 END AS contained_qty
RETURN sum(direct_qty + contained_qty) AS total_demand
```
